title: Make the robot wave
brief: Move one joint left and right safely three times.
starterPython:
robot.home()
joints = robot.get_joints()
joint = "shoulder_pan" if "shoulder_pan" in joints else "base"
for _ in range(3):
  robot.move_joint(joint, 25, speed=40)
  robot.wait(0.3)
  robot.move_joint(joint, -25 if joint == "shoulder_pan" else 105, speed=40)
  robot.wait(0.3)
robot.home()
successCriteria: uses at least two move_joint commands
